chunks: 4437 - And Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Mālik ibn ʿAṭiyyah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"A woman is not married alongside her maternal aunt, but the maternal aunt may be married alongside the daughter of her sister."

key_terms.ابْنَةِ أُخْتِهَا: the daughter of her sister; her niece through her sister
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman; a female party in the marriage ruling

ai.seo_question: Can a woman and her maternal aunt be married to the same man at the same time in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding marriage combinations among close female relatives. It states that a woman is not to be joined in marriage alongside her maternal aunt, while the reverse arrangement involving the maternal aunt and her sister’s daughter is permitted.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4437 - And it is narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Malik ibn Atiyyah, from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"A woman cannot be married alongside her maternal aunt, but the maternal aunt can be married alongside the daughter of her sister."
